lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Important question: does a sunset count as an event if I don't print tickets?

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Jun confiscated my clipboard. I was going to argue, but the harbor looks pretty good without a schedule.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: I can bring lemonade. Want to sit by the water for a bit? That's the entire invitation. Suspicious, I know.

choices.label: Lemonade and a sunset sound good.
choices.reply: Great. I'll bring two cups and exactly zero whistles.

choices.label: Not today. Rain check?
choices.reply: Absolutely. I might even manage to keep the lemonade cold until next time.
